examples.trans: To check my suits and my expense claims.

examples.text: Pour vérifier mes costumes et mes notes de frais. Bonne chance!
examples.trans: To check my suits and my expense claims. Good luck!

meanings.note: Il y a = there is / there are. High-frequency French pronoun meaning 'there'; clitic object forms precede the conjugated verb.
J'y pense = I think about it. High-frequency French pronoun meaning 'there'; clitic object forms precede the conjugated verb.

examples.text: S'il vous plaît. Il n'y a rien entre Mathias et moi, d'accord?
examples.trans: Please. There's nothing between Mathias and me, okay?

meanings.note: Place: à Paris, à mon cours. Core French preposition meaning 'at', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.
Time: à midi. Core French preposition meaning 'at', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
